✨ scryer | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated media library management and organization, with a particular focus on efficient handling of anime content.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted media management for movies, TV series, and anime • Monitors libraries and tracked titles • Searches for releases through indexers • Evaluates releases against quality and rules policies • Coordinates downloads and imports
📖 Summary: Scryer is a self-hosted media management application written in Rust, designed to efficiently handle movies, TV series, and anime. It automates the process of monitoring libraries, searching for releases, evaluating quality, coordinating downloads, organizing files, and managing subtitles, all within a single, compiled binary.
